text_block_list.text:
The plan for Нарита Таисин was to have a
dance
lesson so she could prepare for
her winning
concerts, but...
Winning concerts, huh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: That's not it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm just not the type of racer that wants
to show
gratitude to my fans or thank
them for supporting
me like the others
do.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: The only person I race for is myself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Even those concerts... I just don't know...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
But whatever—I'll do it if I have to.
What's the
song today?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Although Нарита Таисин looks conflicted
about
the whole thing, we finally get the
lesson started.

Нарита Таисин sings and dances with a
skill that
belies her lackluster attitude,
making it almost
seem like an act!
Phew.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hello? Could you say something instead
of
spacing out? The song's over.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I think I'm tearing up. That was amazing!

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Uh... You're getting way too excited.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I just don't want people to be like, "Oh
wow, she
won a race, but she can't even
dance and sing
properly for us?"
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: It's not anything spe—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Now I want to dance too!

text_block_list.text: It's not anything spe—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Now I want to dance too!

text_block_list.text: Ugh, cut it out already!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Just gimme some pointers about what I
need to
improve! You're my trainer, so
do your job and
help me train!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
...It appears I've embarrassed her too
much.

Taishin, Taishin! Whatcha reading? News
about a
new game?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: ...Butt out.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a dancing game where you move
your whole
body? You usually play
mobile games, so I'm
surprised you're
interested in this one!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Huh? The heck are you talking about?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She looks unimpressed with me, but I
can't sit still.
My body begins to move to
the beat on its own.

Whoa... Hey, stop! Seriously, what are
you
doing?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Look at you—you have absolutely no
sense of
rhythm.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Listen to the song more carefully...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I said, butt out!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I don't know when our trainer-student
roles
reversed, but regardless, we end
up having a fun
day together.
